items.title: 'If you started running, they shot you' - inside Nigeria's growing kidnapping crisis
items.summary: Many communities are living in fear of being kidnapped for ransom as the crisis spreads further south.
items.titleZh: “如果你开始逃跑，他们就会开枪”——尼日利亚日益严重的绑架危机
items.summaryZh: 随着危机进一步向南蔓延，许多社区都生活在被绑架勒索赎金的恐惧中。

items.title: World's first patient to undergo live AI-assisted brain surgery has tumour removed
items.summary: Without brain surgery guided by live AI assistance, Rhys Hibbert could have lost his sight to a tumour.
items.titleZh: 世界上第一位接受人工智能辅助脑部手术的患者已经切除了肿瘤
items.summaryZh: 如果没有实时人工智能辅助指导的脑部手术，Rhys Hibbert可能会因肿瘤而失明。

items.title: Tempe turns off its Flock license plate reader system, citing privacy concerns and risk for 'misuse'
items.summary: The Arizona city ended its relationship with Flock, saying that the "risk of misuse is too great" and that the cameras will be taken down.
items.titleZh: 坦佩以隐私问题和“滥用”风险为由关闭了Flock车牌阅读器系统
items.summaryZh: 亚利桑那州结束了与Flock的关系，称“滥用风险太大”，摄像头将被拆除。

items.title: Russian Influence Network Used ChatGPT to Masquerade as Academic Experts
items.summary: The operation promoted a purported Israeli think tank that published copied scholarship under academics’ names and circulated pro-Russian analysis across social media.
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯影响力网络利用ChatGPT伪装成学术专家
items.summaryZh: 该行动推广了一个所谓的以色列智库，该智库以学者的名义发布了复制的奖学金，并在社交媒体上传播了亲俄分析。

items.title: Why Did John Ratcliffe Go to Moscow?
items.summary: Despite Trump’s claims, the CIA director’s visit was anything but routine. It might be a sign that Putin is getting more dangerous.
items.titleZh: 约翰·拉特克利夫为什么去莫斯科？
items.summaryZh: 尽管特朗普声称，但这位中央情报局局长的访问绝不是例行公事。这可能是普京变得越来越危险的迹象。

items.title: Nvidia revenue doubles on continued AI demand
items.summary: Chipmaker's $96bn quarter beat forecasts as demand for AI hardware continues to accelerate.
items.titleZh: Nvidia的收入在持续的人工智能需求下翻了一番
items.summaryZh: 随着对人工智能硬件的需求持续加速，芯片制造商本季度960亿美元的收入超过了预期。

items.title: Anthropic continues compute-gobbling streak in $45 billion deal with Nscale
items.summary: The new deal with the infrastructure provider is the latest example of Anthropic's white-hot compute-gobbling streak.
items.titleZh: Anthropic在与Nscale的450亿美元交易中继续计算吞噬连胜
items.summaryZh: 与基础设施提供商的新协议是Anthropic白热化计算吞噬的最新例子。

items.title: Former CFTC Commissioner: Wall Street has used these financial contracts for decades. Now a goat herder does too
items.summary: Because of prediction markets, for the first time ever, small businesses have access to risk management tools that Wall Street has used for years.
items.titleZh: 前CFTC专员：华尔街几十年来一直使用这些金融合约。现在牧羊人也这么做了
items.summaryZh: 由于预测市场，小企业有史以来第一次可以使用华尔街多年来使用的风险管理工具。

items.title: Genesis is no longer a dark horse in the luxury space, and the GV90 proves it
items.summary: The GV90 is peak SUV luxury, complete with lavish features, coach doors, and every bell and whistle. Genesis is growing faster than any luxury marque to date, but this is just the start.
items.titleZh: Genesis不再是奢侈品领域的黑马，GV90证明了这一点
items.summaryZh: GV90是豪华SUV的巅峰之作，配备了豪华的功能、教练车门和每一个铃铛和哨子。Genesis的增长速度比迄今为止任何奢侈品牌都快，但这仅仅是个开始。

items.title: Don’t praise Meta ‘for what the court orders them to do’: Meta will only pay the full $17.1 billion settlement if TikTok and YouTube match it
items.summary: State attorneys general guaranteed $12.1 billion. Meta says it's holding back $5.3 billion unless its rivals sign on.
items.titleZh: 不要赞扬Meta“法院命令他们做的事情”：如果TikTok和YouTube匹配，Meta只会支付全部171亿美元的和解金
items.summaryZh: 州检察长担保121亿美元。Meta表示，除非竞争对手签约，否则将扣留53亿美元。

items.title: How do we explain OpenAI's executive exodus?
items.summary: How do we explain OpenAI's executive exodus? | TechCrunchtechcrunch.com
items.titleZh: 我们如何解释OpenAI的高管流失？
items.summaryZh: 我们如何解释OpenAI的高管流失？| TechCrunchtechcrunch.com

items.title: These EV chargers hang from garage ceilings
items.summary: Voltpost made its name turning lampposts into EV chargers. Now it wants to hang them from garage ceilings and bolt them to apartment-building walls.
items.titleZh: 这些电动汽车充电器挂在车库天花板上
items.summaryZh: Voltpost以将灯柱变成电动汽车充电器而闻名。现在，它想把它们挂在车库的天花板上，用螺栓固定在公寓楼的墙上。

items.title: Anthropic and Nscale strike $45 billion cloud deal, sources say
items.summary: Anthropic will rent around 460 megawatts of compute capacity at an Nscale data center development in West Virgina, according to sources.
items.titleZh: 消息人士称，Anthropic和Nscale达成450亿美元的云协议
items.summaryZh: 据消息人士透露，Anthropic将在西弗吉尼亚州的Nscale数据中心开发项目租用约460兆瓦的计算能力。

items.title: Anthropic wants investors to believe its ‘total addressable market’ is worth $30 trillion—nearly the size of the entire US economy
items.summary: As the Claude maker reportedly prepares for a $2 trillion IPO, it is pitching investors on an addressable market roughly equal to the entire U.S. GDP.
items.titleZh: Anthropic希望投资者相信其“总目标市场”价值30万亿美元，几乎相当于整个美国经济的规模
items.summaryZh: 据报道，随着克劳德制造商准备进行2万亿美元的首次公开募股，它正在向投资者推销一个大致相当于整个美国国内生产总值的潜在市场。

items.title: Hyundai CEO says your local car dealership could sell you a humanoid robot
items.summary: Hyundai's robotics company, Boston Dynamics, could sell humanoid and dog-like bots at car dealerships, the CEO said.
items.titleZh: 现代汽车首席执行官表示，你当地的汽车经销商可以卖给你一个人形机器人
items.summaryZh: 这位首席执行官表示，现代汽车的机器人公司波士顿动力公司可以在汽车经销商处销售人形和类狗机器人。
